description: People like a given one: the same role family and the skills they share, optionally in one country. For a shortlist built from a good candidate. Free; limits by trust: no account 50 profile reads and 20 searches a day per network, a wallet signed in with SIWX 100 and 50, an Alion account 1,000 and 200, a verified company 5,000 and 1,000. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs
